g.text: QRWTY | a durable record before the redirect
REVISION 2 — every eligible GET redirect waits. A delayed dashboard is different from failed event storage.
Solid: request / read Dashed: channel delivery Amber: product rule Proposed, not deployed
ACK must precede response. A crash afterward can record an attempt whose response never reaches the browser.
Never extend cache validity or return a redirect from an unconfirmed memory buffer.
Delayed processing: catch up and reconcile. Missing accepted record: incident. Stop new traffic if safety cannot hold.
Regional multi-zone durability at launch. Zero loss after whole-region destruction needs an additional synchronous-copy design.
